title: discovery: probe_url tests missing pre-bracketed IPv6 edge case
description: probe_url tests cover bare IPv6 ('fd7a::1') and IPv4 ('127.0.0.1') but not a pre-bracketed input like '[fd7a::1]'. The double-bracket bug (KITH-ygr0.10) would not be caught by the current test suite. A test asserting probe_url('[fd7a::1]', 4430) == 'https://[fd7a::1]:4430/.well-known/jmap' should be added as a regression guard.
